instruction: Build authentication middleware using Fastify hooks and decorators
relevant_when: Agent builds authentication or authorization in a Fastify application
context: Proactively check that the agent uses Fastify hooks and decorators correctly for auth: decorateRequest for per-request user state, preHandler hook for auth checks, proper TypeScript declarations, and plugin encapsulation so auth hooks are scoped correctly.

checklist.name: decorate-request-for-user
checklist.rule: Agent uses app.decorateRequest() to add a user property to the request object, initialized to null, instead of assigning arbitrary properties to the request
checklist.relevant_when: Agent adds user/auth state to Fastify requests

checklist.name: prehandler-for-auth
checklist.rule: Agent uses a preHandler hook (not onRequest) for authentication/authorization checks, since preHandler runs after body parsing and schema validation
checklist.relevant_when: Agent implements auth checks on Fastify routes

checklist.name: typescript-module-augmentation
checklist.rule: Agent extends the Fastify types using declare module 'fastify' with FastifyRequest interface augmentation to type the user property
checklist.relevant_when: Agent adds custom properties to Fastify request in TypeScript

checklist.name: auth-plugin-encapsulated
checklist.rule: Auth logic is organized as a Fastify plugin. If the auth decorator needs to be shared across all plugins, the plugin is wrapped with fastify-plugin (fp) to break encapsulation intentionally
checklist.relevant_when: Agent builds auth that needs to be available across multiple route plugins

checklist.name: 401-on-missing-auth
checklist.rule: The auth hook sends a 401 status with a structured error response when authentication fails, using reply.send() and returning reply (or throwing) to short-circuit the request
checklist.relevant_when: Agent implements auth middleware in Fastify

checklist.name: request-log-for-auth-failures
checklist.rule: Auth failures are logged using request.log (Fastify's built-in pino logger) rather than console.log
checklist.relevant_when: Agent logs authentication events in Fastify
